subject: math
description: Identify corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior, and same-side interior angle pairs formed by two lines and a transversal.
learningObjectives: Identify the transversal in a diagram with two lines
Distinguish interior angles from exterior angles
Name corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior, and same-side interior angle pairs
Label angle pairs from numbered diagrams
Explain why a pair belongs to a specific transversal vocabulary category
prerequisites: Name angles from diagrams using accurate notation
Recognize intersecting lines and parallel-looking lines
Identify when two angles are on the same side or opposite sides of a line
Use angle labels such as angle 1 or angle ABC clearly
